CustomField.description: Domaine fonctionnel déduit du préfixe de la règle (APEX_/TRIGGER_ = Apex, FLOW_/AUTOMATION_ = Flows & Automation, OBJECT_/FIELD_ = Data Model, VR_ = Data Quality, STORAGE_ = Storage, ADOPTION_ = Adoption, SECURITY_ = Security). Toute nouvelle règle doit suivre cette convention de préfixe.
CustomField.formula: IF(OR(BEGINS(RuleCode__c, "APEX_"), BEGINS(RuleCode__c, "TRIGGER_")), "Apex", IF(OR(BEGINS(RuleCode__c, "FLOW_"), BEGINS(RuleCode__c, "AUTOMATION_")), "Flows & Automation", IF(OR(BEGINS(RuleCode__c, "OBJECT_"), BEGINS(RuleCode__c, "FIELD_")), "Data Model", IF(BEGINS(RuleCode__c, "VR_"), "Data Quality", IF(BEGINS(RuleCode__c, "STORAGE_"), "Storage", IF(BEGINS(RuleCode__c, "ADOPTION_"), "Adoption", IF(BEGINS(RuleCode__c, "SECURITY_"), "Security", "Other")))))))
CustomField.label: Domain
